description: A note window (label note-<id>): reading and writing its own note, its color and keep on top, deleting and closing itself (the backend refuses any other note's ID), answering the backend's save requests before a delete from "All notes" or quitting, creating a new note, opening "All notes", reading the settings, the tray texts, showing itself once loaded, moving the frameless window by its header (start dragging) and listening to the backend's events.
